attempted_claim: Let A(1,R)={z:1<=|z|<=R} on the mesh-1 triangular lattice at p=1/2. Let P_poly(1,R) be the probability of two disjoint opposite-color arms crossing A(1,R) and P_mono(1,R) the probability of two disjoint open arms crossing A(1,R). Then for all R>=50, P_mono(1,R)<=2 R^{-0.01} P_poly(1,R); equivalently the monochromatic two-arm exponent satisfies alpha_mono(2)>=1/4+0.01 in liminf logarithmic ratio.
